spans.s:
Spandana in one passage of the Rigveda denotes a certain tree. Roth, however, reads syandana, ‘chariot.’
Foot notes iii. 53, 19.
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
Cf. Aufrecht, Rigveda, 2, vi; Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 63.
Sparśu is apparently the name of a western people in the baudhāyana śrauta sūtra (xxi. 13).
